headline: Launcher 0.6.0 adds model and texture mods alongside gameplay fixes
summary: Launcher 0.6.0 lets players export models and textures, edit them and manage replacement packs on the Mods page. Earlier releases today add automatic updates, Linux ARM64 builds and a single Ratchet & Clank entry that follows the player's disc. Historical direct development continues alongside releases on today's release-only master.
highlights: 0.5.1 starts and chains in-game cutscenes, fixes wrench throwing and adds in-app updates.
0.5.2 restores missing seas and full walking speed on Rilgar, with Linux ARM64 support.
0.6.0 restores chrome, glass, weapon stances and Gadgetron vendor displays.
Updated level exports restore missing Blaster and Pyrocitor models and are extracted again before Play.
Flatpak packaging was removed after the author reported a Flathub policy rejection.
#12 reports a 0.5.0 AppImage crash on Fedora 44 with GNOME Wayland. Installers remain unsigned.
